82360.subject: Avalanche’s Latest 30 Days: Aave V4, Bitcoin Liquidity and the Growing L1 Economy
82360.body:
View this post on the web at https://www.team1.blog/p/avalanches-latest-30-days-aave-v4

Avalanche has plenty happening beyond the usual transaction counts and trading volumes. Aave V4 is attracting deposits, Bitcoin liquidity remains active, and BlackRock’s BUIDL continues to represent a substantial institutional presence on the network.
Meanwhile, dedicated Avalanche L1s are processing millions of transactions across gaming, trading and other applications. Not every part of the ecosystem is growing at the same pace, but the range of activity is becoming more interesting as different applications build around their own needs.
Want to keep up with the latest in the Avalanche ecosystem? Subscribe to the Team1 blog and get our updates in your inbox weekly.
Aave V4 is gaining traction on Avalanche
One of the more interesting developments in Avalanche DeFi this year has been the arrival of Aave V4. Launched on Avalanche in July, it marked V4’s first expansion beyond Ethereum and introduced a different approach to how lending markets share liquidity.
According to Aavescan’s latest available data, Aave V4 on Avalanche holds approximately $50 million in deposits and $13 million in active loans, with deposits increasing by around $14 million over the past 30 days. Aave V3 remains considerably larger, with approximately $448 million in deposits and $152 million in active loans, although its deposits have declined during the same period.
It is difficult to tell how much capital, if any, is moving directly between the two versions. What we can see is that V4 is beginning to establish a lending market of its own.
The architecture is worth looking at. Instead of relying on separate pools that manage liquidity independently, V4 introduces a shared Liquidity Hub connected to specialized markets. On Avalanche, these include a general lending market, an AVAX Correlated market for liquid staking strategies, and a Forex market focused on stablecoin borrowing and exchange-rate exposure.
This allows assets such as BTC.b, sAVAX, WAVAX, USDC and EURC to be used across markets designed for different borrowing needs.
There is also an institutional angle. Aave’s original Avalanche proposal included plans for a dedicated RWA Hub, which could eventually connect tokenized financial assets with onchain lending. That remains a proposed development rather than one of the live markets covered here, but it is an area worth following given Avalanche’s existing presence in institutional tokenization.
Bitcoin liquidity remains active
BTC.b continues to be one of the more active assets in Avalanche DeFi. Over the latest seven days, it recorded approximately $69.2 million in DEX volume, including $34.9 million in buys and $34.3 million in sells.
The token has around 33,442 holders, while its latest one-day trading volume reached approximately $4.9 million. Buying and selling remain closely balanced, with no obvious rush in either direction.

This week was a landmark step toward the next generation of global financial markets. The upcoming NYSE-affiliated tokenized securities platform’s core clearing and settlement layer will be built on top of Avalanche technology (https://info.avax.network/e3t/Ctc/I6+113/cVNLY04/VWtJWv25Zx2kW8y0SLq2vxJwXW1PHNH55XdJnMN1HNyZC3l5QzW69sMD-6lZ3kYW6VBP5S7SD7rlW8tZJW_1wKpyqN8W2Q7vztD9ZW5mB8nD39DRDGW48KblS1Byg2xW5-8CbJ3Kfw9DW8XzTh_3Q5KL_W8MYkkP42gKK3W3PFMdj6vM9MXW5kVw4w6q8hmrN6zBXJsd5MgRW4Ybw9n4MV2PYV-464k3qJXqMW6sHSws50ghjKW1Jzsbk3mMHJFW8DqGQv4tWhJjN838p3bJqh72W4n0QVM1MwC2xW2WdF9g61RNwJW8hBD1x8rWNtCf3Z9Dg004 ) .

82299.subject: your free trial ends tomorrow
82299.body:
Hey Oleg,

Quick heads-up: your athletedata free trial ends tomorrow, and your subscription kicks in right after - so your card will be charged €69 then.

To keep your training data wired into your AI tool, do nothing. It carries straight on.

One thing worth knowing: the chat coach on iMessage, Telegram and WhatsApp was part of your trial, but it isn't part of the MCP plan. When the trial converts, the MCP server keeps answering and the coach goes quiet. If you'd rather keep the coach, you can switch plans instead.

And if it's not for you, cancel any time before tomorrow and you won't be charged.

Manage your plan: https://www.athletedata.health/dashboard/billing

Either way, just reply if anything's unclear - this inbox is managed by the two of us directly.

Julian & Daniel

PS: Want to talk through your setup or anything that hasn't clicked yet before the trial ends? Grab a slot with us: https://cal.eu/team/athletedata/feedback-call
